_why: The spec has no `customer` field on a checkout, neither in CheckoutSessionSaveRequestDTO nor in CheckoutSessionResponseDTO. Asaas's own reference page for POST /v3/checkouts says the opposite: "to associate the Checkout with a customer already registered in Asaas, send its ID in `customer`", never together with `customerData`; and the CHECKOUT_CREATED example on the checkout events page carries `checkout.customer`. Without the field in the schema, Elysia prunes it from the body before the handler runs, so a checkout opened for an existing customer silently lost it and its payment had no customer to bill. spec/openapi.json stays untouched so the drift diff against upstream stays clean.

value.description: Unique identifier of an existing customer in Asaas. Do not send together with customerData
Unique identifier of the customer in Asaas
